messages:
anya (People Ops): Quick pilot: rolling out 'Signal Confidence Cards' 1 — a tiny add-on to GEM/OIL to mark how reliable each piece of evidence is (High/Medium/Low) + a one-line rationale. Link: https://go.redwood/scc. Please pilot with 2-3 KRs this cycle.
omar (Eng): Interesting. So this is a metadata tag for evidence rows?
anya (People Ops): Yup. Example: Evidence: "A/B funnel lift 4% (p<0.05)" -> Confidence: High -> Rationale: 10k users, 2-week window, consistent across segments.
rachel (PM): How do managers use this in calibration?
anya (People Ops): Calibration guidance in doc: treat High as strong signal for impact; Medium = needs corroboration (another data source); Low = qualitative / early-signal. We'll surface confidence distribution in calibration packet.
ben (Manager): Can you share phrasing templates for reviewers to call out confidence disagreements? want to standardize feedback.
anya (People Ops): Sure 1 included three micro-phrases in the doc:
- Agree: "Agree with High confidence 1 clear methodology & artifact linked."
- Ask for more: "I'd downgrade to Medium 1 can you add sampling window and segmentation?"
- Pushback: "I think this is Low confidence due to small sample size; please add corroborating metrics or user examples."
calib-bot: Reminder: Calibration exports use the snapshot on 2026-05-18. Add confidence tags by 2026-05-10 to be included.
omar (Eng): Are we going to make this a required field? lightweight is key.
anya (People Ops): Not required for this pilot; strongly encouraged. We made a 1-click menu in the template for quick tagging.
rachel (PM): Any guidance for qualitative evidence (user interviews)? how to pick High vs Medium?
anya (People Ops): Guidance: High if multiple independent interviews + thematic consistency + customer impact examples; Medium if early themes (n<8) or single-customer story; Low if anecdotal single mention. Short rubric in doc.
ben (Manager): I'll tell my leads to tag a few items and we'll test in calibration. If any team wants an extra column in their export, ping me and I'll coordinate with People Ops.
anya (People Ops): Thanks 1 appreciate pilots. If you want a 10-min walkthrough or the CSV export format, DM me and I'll share. :thumbsup:
